title: Veneered panels and similar laminated wood, with at least one outer ply of non-coniferous wood other than tropical

review.construction: four temperate birch veneers, verified as Betula pendula or Betula pubescens, around a single pine or spruce solid-strip core, with alternating physical axes, unfinished faces and no tropical outer ply
review.classification: The library accepts a narrower CPC 3.0 31423 association for four temperate birch veneers, verified as Betula pendula or Betula pubescens, around a single pine or spruce solid-strip core, with alternating physical axes, unfinished faces and no tropical outer ply. The 23 October 2026 UNSD white-cover publication places the corresponding blockboard explicitly in 31423.01 under the standard five-digit parent (Annex, paragraphs 138–143 and printed p.928). The standard 31413 note still expressly includes blockboard and permits other central-core materials. The five physical layers alternate 0/90/0/90/0. Removing the solid core leaves four veneer axes 0/90/90/0. That sequence alone cannot resolve how to read alternate veneer sheets. The specific sectoral child and its parent rule support this limited interpretation alongside that counterevidence. Verify the actual Betula pendula or Betula pubescens faces and crossbands, pine or spruce strip core, crossed axes, adhesive, supplier and finished state. The Paged technical sheet documents a birch option without identifying the species in a particular lot.
review.competing_evidence: Standard CPC 3.0 31413 continues to name blockboard and to allow central cores of other materials. The core alone or a native dataset label cannot exclude this competing reading. The October expansion independently places these blockboards under the corresponding 3142 parent. The standard 31423 title restricts non-coniferous faces to non-tropical wood. A change in actual wood species, core construction, product state or evidence requires a fresh applicability decision.
review.historical_sources: The November hold, superseded batch-03 evidence, original canonical hashes and original author receipt remain independently traceable. No historical acceptance object is reused for the new edge.
review.study_limits: Verify the actual Betula pendula or Betula pubescens faces and crossbands, pine or spruce strip core, crossed axes, adhesive, supplier and finished state. The Paged technical sheet documents a birch option without identifying the species in a particular lot.
review.review_scope: This adjudication concerns the classification of the retained, previously substantively reviewed bilingual PCR. The prior production route, accounting, measurement requirements, identified inventory gaps, translation review and candidate lifecycle carry forward.
